summary: Every video gets its own music and edit. No fixed template: a spec = brand layer (constant) + music design + free segment list, on one beat clock (tempo map).

brand_layer_constant.tag: diegetic @hayret.piksel, ≥1 legible, ≤3 total, never in captions/first 2 s
brand_layer_constant.captions: narration blocks (5×7 pixel font, mixed case, full Turkish): body 6 / head 9 / title 12 px per dot, ≥5 px floor, UI-safe auto-layout, music-synced reveal + blips; short ALL-CAPS top-box captions optional; turquoise key word, coral 2nd accent
brand_layer_constant.sonic_logo: 4 notes 5→1→2→3 of the current scale, short-short-short-LONG, long note on the reveal downbeat and the loop seam, in the current lead timbre, re-harmonised
brand_layer_constant.pacing: calm by default (shots ~3–5 s, soft shake/flash, slower layers)

variable_per_video: music (bpm, meter, key, scale/makam, progression, voices, drums, motif, sections, tempo changes, sfx map)
structure (segments, durations, scenes, layers, props, camera, transitions, captions, events)

huzzam.character: Hüzzam: segah tonic + hicaz colour (rough approx.)

transitions.crash: camera dives into the outgoing scene's bright focus, cut
transitions.slide: new scene slides over the old (dir)
transitions.push: new scene pushes the old out (dir)
transitions.iris: hayret-eye shaped iris opens on the new scene
transitions.tiles: Çini wipe: 8-point star tiles flip diagonally
transitions.match: match cut on shape: new focus starts where the old one was
transitions.silhouette: morph through a shared glowing silhouette (shape, size)
transitions.spin: old spins away, new spins in
transitions.split: split screen (old top / new bottom), then new takes over
transitions.portal: zoom through the outgoing focus into the new scene
transitions.crt: CRT power-off to a line/dot, power-on into new

archetypes.scale_journey: The reference (Bit Wonder) structure: one protagonist, macro→micro steps, build, hit, big number, metaphor reveal.
archetypes.countdown_top_n: Top-N countdown (5→1). Each item = 2 bars with a different transition; riser + stop before #1; #1 is the payoff.
archetypes.before_after_reveal: Before/after: minor, half-time 'before' → split screen → key change to major + drop on the 'after'.
archetypes.process_timeline: Process / how-it-works: numbered stages chained by match cuts and pushes over an aksak 7/8 groove.
archetypes.myth_vs_fact: Myth vs fact: state the myth (glitchy, unstable), CRT power-off, stop, then the fact lands on a drop.
archetypes.cosmic_zoom_out: Zoom out to cosmic scale: each portal jumps a power of ten; music accelerates (bpm ramp) and opens into lydian.
archetypes.impossible_number: Build-up to an impossible number: numbers escalate every 4–6 s, accelerando + risers, the number lands on the drop.
archetypes.story_vignette: Micro story: a character (hero/image), a problem, a surprising turn, the science answer, a warm payoff.

scenes_added_fraktal.fractal_staff: scrolling pixel staff playing an integer series; modes play|nest|every4 (zoom into a note → same staff; every 4th note burns and falls to a bass staff); converge_to_frame0 for loops
scenes_added_fraktal.koch: Koch snowflake growing one level per beat with echo outlines, inner counter flake, note sparks
scenes_added_fraktal.series_tree: binary tree a(2n)=−a(n), a(2n+1)=a(n)+1 growing a level per beat; sounding note's ancestor path lit
scenes_added_fraktal.shepard_stairs: endless spiral staircase of piano keys (one octave per turn), Gaussian brightness over height
scenes_added_fraktal.mandel_zoom: numpy Mandelbrot deep zoom with beat-stepped colour bands and note emitters
scenes_added_fraktal.object kind vinyl: record with a note spiral synced to the needle and a legible cream label (handle) — legible tag object

scenes_added_story.future_book: hooded hero (sprites.HERO) at a forked road with a hovering BOOK OF THE FUTURE (3-frame page flips, big arrow page), sky clock with 2-beat pendulum, prophecy piano-roll of a series in the lower third (ghost future notes, whisper halo one 8th early); modes read | avoid (turn_at, ink crack, ✗ on predicted notes the actual_series skips) | open (cover opens, converges to frame 0)
scenes_added_story.laplace_demon: many-eyed demon (9 tracking eyes) over a deterministic billiard table (pre-rolled sim, dotted future paths revealed per beat, collision ticks on the 16th grid) + abacus
scenes_added_story.dominoes: domino run on a Bézier S-curve before a grandfather clock (glyph numerals, 2-beat pendulum, plate slot on the case); one falls per fall_every (4-frame fall + tick), preroll_down already down; split: top endless mechanical conveyor vs bottom 'thinker' domino that opens its eyes, looks around and hops onto a türkuaz side branch
scenes_added_story.libet_clock: Libet clock (60 ticks, coral spot per period_s with tail, W marker), EEG strip scrolling then time-locked to a button press (hero's sleeve + finger), readiness ramp from a Schurger 2012 leaky stochastic accumulator; at noise_at the ramp splits into noise_trials single trials whose average is the ramp
scenes_added_story.future_tree: dice: real 3-D pixel dice (6-frame quarter-turn tumble per roll_every), sprouting paths, contracting coral countdown ring, frozen last beat; burst: seeded binary futures tree (depth, grow_every, pre_gens; un-grown futures as dotted ghosts), zoom-constant 2–3 px paths, blinking lamps, ghost hero walkers, chosen root→leaf path burns türkuaz
scenes_added_story.object kind book: hardcover on a desk with candle (3-frame flame, dust motes) and inkwell; open at frame 0 (arrow page), closes at close_at with a thud; cover = eye emblem + 2-dot snapped title + 2-line handle on a matte ink plate (legible tag object); cover aspect matches future_book's small cover for match cuts
scenes_added_story.sprites: sprites.py: multi-colour char-map sprites; the mascot HERO (16×22: front blink look_l look_r read wow walk1-3 turn), draw_sprite(scale, flip, tint, alpha, squash), hero_frame(state, lb)

visual_change_every_s.note: narration reveal counts as change (1 per s of reveal)

quality_rules.loop: seamless (loop_transition into frame 0, audio tail wrapped)

text_readability.legibility_basis: cap height ≥ 22 arcmin on a 5.4" phone (124 mm tall) at 35 cm (ISO 9241-303); recognition 100 % after 720p+blur+JPEG-40 from 3 px/dot

style.description: optional starting point; every key overrides it

progression.description: roman (diatonic: I ii V; forced: bVI V7 viio) | chord names (Em C#m7 Fmaj7) | note lists

pattern.description: arp: up down updown broken alberti pedal groups oompah · bass: chip root8 octave walk pump groups waltz sustain | [semitones|null]

table.description: wave: bass organ pluck soft | 32×4-bit list

series.description: integer-sequence melody on the global beat grid: index = floor(beat*rate/div) → scale degree sign*a(i)+offset in the section scale (diatonic, follows key/scale changes). Slower voices of the same series land on every 2nd/4th… note of faster ones (self-similarity). Custom finite melodies: music.series_defs {name: {values:[ints], period:N}} (shared by music and visuals); lookahead k = the voice plays k notes in the future (slot n → value n+k).

oneOf.description: norgard or a name from music.series_defs

lookahead.description: slot n plays value n+k (a voice that is k notes ahead, e.g. a whisper)

drums.description: none|four_on_floor|breakbeat|trap|half_time|boom_bap|maqsum|aksak_9_8|aksak_7_8|waltz|six_eight|shuffle|march|dnb|auto|{K,S,C,H,O,D,T,M,R,Z: step string X x o r .}

motif.description: {notes:[degrees|null], rhythm:[beats]} or {contour: arch rise fall wave valley zigzag question flat, range, density, seed, cadence}

bpm_to.description: linear tempo ramp to this BPM by the section end (accel/ritardando)

riser.description: riser into the next section; drums drop out

stop.description: beats of silence at the end (held breath ≤ 1.5 s)

drop.description: hit + crash + shake/flash on the first beat

riser_kind.description: noise = classic sweep; shepard = Shepard–Risset endless rising chip tone (needs riser:true)

shepard_hops.description: hop blips per beat in a shepard riser (default 2)

sections.description: omit → one section per segment, behaviour from roles (build=riser, hit/drop=drop, hold=stop)

logo.description: true | {at: ['reveal','loop'] | beats} — the 4-note sonic logo, transposed into the section's key/scale/timbre

series_defs.description: named finite integer melodies usable as series (music voices AND scenes, e.g. future_book roll_series)

transition_in.description: name or {type, beats, align, dir, shape, size, sfx}

caption.description: short ALL-CAPS top-box caption (≤3 lines; never below 5 px/dot). Prefer narration for sentences.

layer_sync.description: loop segment: reuse the first segment's layer stack on the film-loop clock (t−T) so the last frame equals frame 0

text.description: full sentence(s); *türkuaz* _mercan_ highlights; \n forced break. Turkish wrap + syllable hyphenation automatic

until.description: end beat (segment-relative) | 'segment' | omitted = auto (reveal + reading time + hold, clamped to the segment)

size.description: body 6 px/dot (≈24 chars, ≤5 lines) | head 9 (≈15, ≤3) | title 12 | int ≥ 5 (measured legible minimum)

rate.description: auto | 32nd 16th 8th triplet beat half | beats per step

blip.description: soft chiptune blip on reveal steps (SFX kinds blip / blip_hi, ≈−28 dB in the mix)

cursor.description: default on for reveal=type (blinks on 8ths once complete)

hold.description: extra seconds after the reading time (auto until)

target.description: callout pointer: [x, y] scene coords or 'focus'

surface.description: world text: {x, y, w (scene units), dot (scene units per font dot, default 1), rot, fill, ink: dark, outline}

xy.description: explicit block centre [fx, fy] as screen fractions

narration.description: narrator text blocks (recipe §12.6) — the main text system; caption stays for short ALL-CAPS lines

subject.description: box auto-layout avoids: [x0,y0,x1,y1] scene coords | radius around the scene focus | 'none' (default focus ± 40)

pacing.description: how hard the edit hits (recipe §12.7). calm = default since Oct 2026; punchy = the first two reels

narration_defaults.description: defaults merged into every narration block (e.g. {"blip": false, "place": "dialog"})

readability.description: reading-time rule: a block must stay readable ≥ base + per_word·words seconds after it is fully revealed

reference_example.title: {{title}}
reference_example.logline: Follow one {{protagonist}} through {{topic}} until it becomes one of {{N}} — and all of it fits in a {{metaphor_object}}.

music.note: music-only, no VO; steady electronic/lo-fi pulse; rescale beats if BPM differs

look.medium: pixel art, pseudo-3D shaded round forms, Bayer dither, dithered bloom, dust motes
look.accent_rule: amber only for energy/signal and the key number; amber area grows across the film

typography.font: bitloop built-in 5x7 pixel font (full-height Turkish capitals); 12 px/dot, 120 px pitch

look.color_arc: violet dark with amber dot → amber flood → network sparks → whole object glows gold → back to dot

borrowed_from_reference: one tiny protagonist followed across scales
5 causal steps, one per 8 beats, 2–4-word caption
only 3 hard cuts, all on beats; rest continuous push/pull morphs
wordless build + held breath + downbeat hit + scale burst
everyday metaphor object with brand etched in-world
seamless loop: last frame = first frame

slots.action: per-shot action, written at plan time

slot_rules.steps: cause→effect, 2–4 words; exactly one step carries a number
slot_rules.title: ≤6 words incl. a number, ends with 🎧

shots.summary: HOOK: {{protagonist}} already in action; amber data cue at bottom
shots.camera_note: slow push_in + slight orbit; last 0.6 s crash-zoom into bright point

shots.summary: STEP 1 macro: {{step1_visual}}; amber flood on a note
shots.transition_in: HARD CUT on beat, match on scale

shots.camera_note: tilt/roll into steep diagonal perspective, track to next part

shots.summary: STEP 5 + BUILD: {{step5_visual}}; contracting amber ring + growing glow; hold 0.4 s
HIT: chain closes — flare + shockwave; fast pull-out to {{system_view}}; spark waves
shots.camera_note: fast pull_out ~2 s then slow drift
shots.ref_what: ref B7 24.0-30.5s: HIT: next neuron fires -> network

shots.summary: BIG NUMBER: system particles assemble into {{system_silhouette}}; gold waves
METAPHOR: {{metaphor_object}} materialises around the system; brand etched on it
LOOP: push through object → system → land exactly on frame 0
shots.ref_what: ref B10 44.6-48.0s: Loop back to start

text_overlay.note: fades back in to match frame 0

peaks.build: caption out, contracting amber ring, glow grows
peaks.hit: flare + shockwave on downbeat, hard cut
peaks.after: fast pull-out to system, no text
